mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) over a 4-quarter horizon signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days, particularly when the decline is accompanied by a simultaneous drop in industrial production (INDPRO).
failure_condition: If the GDP growth rate declines by more than 2% annually but S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.10) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the producer price index (PPI) over a 6-month horizon signals rising input costs that erode corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially when accompanied by a decline in the housing market (HOUST).
failure_condition: If PPI rises by more than 3% annually but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between PPI and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.15) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over a 12-month horizon signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when the increase is accompanied by a decline in consumer spending (CPIAUCSL).
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate rises by more than 2% annually but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.10) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 6-month horizon signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly when accompanied by a decline in industrial production (INDPRO).
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate declines by more than 1% but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.10) in a rolling 5-year window.
